Cc: Richard O'Connell <richard.oconnell@statelybank.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: High error rate and latency spikes this morning (production)

Monica —

We saw sustained 5xx errors and p50/p95 latency jumps across two routes (generate/text and chat/stream) between 01:12–02:04 UTC this morning. Throughput for our tenant doubled briefly, and our customers experienced timeouts. Our security team wants an evidentiary package today: logs, retention stamps, and an explanation of what was captured during the incident window. Please confirm what artifacts Redwood can provide that are safe for cross-company sharing (we cannot receive raw customer payloads).

Thanks,
Grace
Principal Platform Ops, StatelyBank

(Attachment: cust-email-thread-extern.pdf)
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Grace Liang <grace.liang@statelybank.com>, Richard O'Connell <richard.oconnell@statelybank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate and latency spikes this morning (production)

Hi Grace —

I'm escalating this immediately and assembling the artifacts you requested. Short answers up front:
- We can provide traces (trace ids and timing), aggregated latency histograms, sampled error stacks, and a sanitized log bundle with PII redacted.
- We will NOT provide raw payloads containing customer prompt content unless there is an explicit legal/data transfer agreement — but we can provide hashed identifiers and token counts.
- We will produce a signed manifest describing how the evidence was exported and when (chain-of-custody).

Action plan I'm kicking off now:
1) Rishi: collect service traces + the kv cache hit/miss summary for window 2027-06-09T01:00:00Z–2027-06-09T03:00:00Z and produce a tokenized list of trace IDs (no prompt text).
2) Stephanie: prepare a redaction outline and confirm retention timestamps for the logs we plan to hand off.
3) Marissa: coordinate an exec sync if Stately wants to escalate to their CISO.

I will send an interim package in ~2 hours.

— Monica Patel
Escalations Lead, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate and latency spikes this morning (production)

Folks —

Collected traces and initial artifacts. Summary:
- Collected 120 trace IDs that show 5xx propagation; attached tokenized-trace-ids.txt (trace id list only).
- Error bursts correlate with an autoscaler jitter event and a transient failed connection to the redis-kv cluster. We observed a KV miss spike at 01:18:43Z; consistent with a TTL staleness that increased serialization time.
- Attached svc-error-sample-20270609.json: three sampled error stacks (redacted).

Notes on redaction: I removed prompt text and any full user messages; kept hashed request IDs and token counts. I also replaced IPs with <IP_REDACTED> placeholders as requested.

Let me know if Stately needs a deeper slice (we can pull additional traces) — but we should get legal sign-off before exporting anything more detailed.

-Rishi
Senior SRE, Runtime
From: Richard O'Connell <richard.oconnell@statelybank.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Grace Liang <grace.liang@statelybank.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate and latency spikes this morning (production)

Monica / Rishi —

Thanks for the rapid response. A few clarifying asks from our side: 1) Can Redwood provide a signed hash manifest (SHA256) of the exported artifacts and a timestamp of when they were pulled from live storage? 2) What is Redwood's default retention for production diagnostics logs and traces? 3) We need confirmation that no customer prompt content will be included.

We may request a forensics package for legal review; please mark the artifacts as 'legal hold' if requested.

-Rich
Sr. Incident Manager, StatelyBank
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate and latency spikes this morning (production)

Grace/Rich —

Answering the specific asks:
- Signed manifest: yes — we'll produce a manifest with checksums (SHA256) for each file and a PGP signature from our evidence account. Manifest will include origin S3 key, export timestamp (UTC), and file size.
- Retention: production diagnostics (structured traces + service logs) are retained for 90 days by default. High-fidelity payloads (user data) are ephemeral and retained per-tenant policy; we can produce only metadata/hashes unless a data transfer agreement is in place.
- Customer prompt content: confirmed NOT included. All exported artifacts will have user content redacted or hashed.

I'll attach the manifest and the initial redaction checklist in the interim package. Planning to upload artifacts to a presigned S3 share and send links to the contacts on this thread.

(Stephanie)
Evidence & Compliance Coordinator

Grace — Rich —

Attached is the interim evidence package per our plan: tokenized-trace-ids.txt, svc-error-sample-20270609.json, and a one-page manifest describing export times and checksums. Links: https://presigned.redwood.example/s/INF-9842/package-20270609 (expires 7 days).

Next steps:
- If Stately requests a legal hold, reply-all with explicit hold scope (which files) and we will mark those artifacts and retain a copy for 1 year pending legal review.
- If you want deeper raw traces, we require a DTA or an approved NDA amendment; we can start procurement immediately.

Happy to hop on a call to walk through redaction approach and the chain-of-custody PDF.

— Monica
